title: phase-aware-canary-pauser-and-backpressure-detector
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: Recent incidents showed rapid traffic bursts could trigger aggressive rollouts and cascade retries that look like regressions even when the candidate is healthy. This PR introduces a phase-aware canary pauser and a lightweight backpressure detector to differentiate transient traffic spikes and system backpressure from genuine model performance regressions, and to automatically pause or throttle the canary traffic in a controlled way. High-level changes: 1) Phase-aware Canary Pauser: adds a new canary state machine with phases (probe, monitor, steady) and allows short, policy-driven pauses between phases when signal quality is low. Pauses are stratified by traffic slice (user-agent, route, priority bucket) to avoid global halts. 2) Backpressure Detector: implements a probabilistic backpressure signal derived from queue length, worker saturation, and 95/99 tail latency joint probability; it exposes a short-lived backpressure score used to trigger graduated throttles and prefer-fallback routing. 3) Safe fallback policy: integrates with routing to shift a small percentage of traffic to a lower-capacity model variant or regional pool instead of full rollback when backpressure is detected. 4) Observability and alerting: adds per-phase metrics, backpressure score histogram, and a dashboard with example alert thresholds and runbook links. 5) Tests and canary harness changes: synthetic load tests and a deterministic simulator for phase transitions. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag perf.phase_pauser=true; gradually enable for internal perf-canaries first, monitor metrics for two weeks, then baseline external canaries. Checklist: [x] unit and integration tests, [x] end-to-end simulator test, [x] dashboard and alert panels, [x] feature flag gating, [x] docs updates in perf playbook. Commits summary: (1) add phase state machine and pauser logic, (2) implement backpressure score calculator and probe hooks, (3) routing integration and safe-fallback policy, (4) synthetic load scenarios and simulator, (5) dashboards and alert rules, (6) tests and CI tweaks. Impact: aims to reduce false-positive canary rollbacks by avoiding hasty rollbacks during traffic spikes and to protect underlying serving fleet from overload. Related: ENG-3421 adds the canary lifecycle API used here, SUP-9082 covers a customer incident that motivated early backpressure metrics.
